Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 1041/2024

Dear Mr. Natarajan,

Thank you for meeting us on 8 April 2025 about your dispute with Madhuri Joshi. As we understand it, the spouses agree on a single payment instead of maintenance. The matter is listed before the Family Court at Ahmedabad.

Our advice is to record the one-time alimony settlement in the consent terms. Please collect income tax returns and the draft consent terms and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
